blocks.x: Quantum & Advanced Compute applied to Capabilities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Healthcare & Life Sciences, quantum & advanced compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Genomic and longitudinal data exposure
Genomes and decade-long clinical histories are the definition of long-lived secrets; cryptographic posture is undocumented.
Clinician burden and documentation debt
Physicians spend hours daily on notes, orders and inbox; burnout drives attrition. Documentation AI exists but stalls on integration with the EHR and on compliance sign-off.
Prior authorization and RCM friction
Prior auth, coding and denial management consume staff across payer-provider boundaries. Denials arrive for documentation that existed but was never surfaced.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR / EU health-data regimes and HIPAA / HITECH. PHI safeguards, BAAs, breach notification and audit trails. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
